title: 官方天津较近时期固定尾段：候选选择之后的事前统计分析方案
design_timing: allocation_readout is selected as this new stage primary after inspecting prior V1/V2/V3 and SWEWT supplement results, before any model prediction/performance output for the newly acquired official 2023-2026 tail. This does not rename the old V3 primary or make this model design globally preregistered.
execution_binding: The new runner protocol must bind this exact plan SHA before any model fitting, store its own output path/source hashes, and verify the plan SHA again on completion. Runner/output paths are recorded there rather than filled into this immutable analysis plan later.
fold_label: fixed602020; any legacy year field is a fold identifier, not a calendar year
target_definition: Official TJEA daily total transaction mean price CNY/tonne, with total volume tonnes and turnover CNY, taken from the first TJEA table; not cumulative values, not listing-only values and not closing price.

data_identity.source_type: ordinary public Body.js linked by the official page; acquired and parsed without execution by the data audit
data_identity.sorting_and_filtering: All 1077 TJEA daily-total rows retained, unique dates sorted ascending; no deletion, filling, interpolation, outlier replacement or target recomputation.
data_identity.published_price_rounding: Retain official published two-decimal price. Max abs(price-turnover/volume) is approximately 0.005000000000002558; do not require the old ScienceDB exact-mean identity or replace price by turnover/volume.
data_identity.old_source_disagreement: The old 457 ScienceDB Tianjin dates are available in the official history but 178 records have source-value differences under the data audit rule. These differences do not trigger deletion or outcome-based selection. The new tail has no old-date overlap.
data_identity.vintage_scope: Current public historical snapshot, not certified per-day historical vintages. The point-in-time availability assumption is current reported price/volume known after the origin report.

launch_date_gate.enforcement: Do not start the new stage if prepared identity changes, the tail starts on/before2017-12-31, or any new tail source date overlaps old V3 source dates. Resolve a changed source before fitting; do not move boundaries after outcomes.
launch_date_gate.raw_qc_is_not_blindness: Data values were acquired and quality-checked before fitting; only the new-tail model-performance evaluation is held for this fixed stage.

other_models: Report every fixed family by horizon and overall. Models outside the five contrasts provide descriptive context, with no new post-result significance comparisons.

strong_baseline_selection.rule: Choose minimum validation loss with exact ties in stated order. Keep SWEWTfull as its own fixed primary comparator. Report the selected strong baseline as additional context, not a substitute for any of the five declared contrasts.

split.boundary_rule: A=floor(.6*N); B=A+floor(.2*N), preserving sequential60/20/20; not floor(.8*N).
split.origin_set: t=64,...,N-21; issue after observing row t; target p[t+h]-p[t]. Horizons count observed transaction records, not calendar days.
split.test: t>=B and t+20<N; all horizons use the same origins

training_and_information.reuse_frozen_methods: Preserve existing architectures, model-native initialization, two LRs .003/.01, weighted H1/H5/H20 loss, fixed original-training-prefix RMS and horizon second moments; no budget adaptation to new-tail outcomes.
training_and_information.selection: Seed17 validates each model actual own forward; max80 epochs/min15/patience12 with improvement threshold1e-7; epoch0 eligible and disclosed; exact selected-loss LR tie broken by LR value.
training_and_information.refit: Fresh seeds17/29/43, each trained over the matured train+validation prefix for the selected fixed epoch count; no further validation/test epoch choice.
training_and_information.optimization: Existing AdamW, weight_decay1e-4, gradient clipping5, batch128; record actual epochs, positive-gradient counts and parameter-change receipts, including zero-epoch refits.
training_and_information.exogenous: Same three EIA energy series with backward as-of date at least14 calendar days before each target record; historical public snapshot is not vintage-certified.
training_and_information.volume: Current log1p total volume minus prior60observed-record median, divided by prior std floored.25, clipped[-5,5], >=10 prior observations; price/volume are assumed known after origin report.
training_and_information.readout_information: Retain the original allocation_readout/constant price+energy information views; neither is silently changed to take volume.
training_and_information.swewt: Reuse fixed past64price EWT N3, last17 raw+band rows, GRU32, 4/9input arms with same last17auxiliary rule and two-LR/80epoch/three-seed budget. Not numerical author reproduction.
training_and_information.source_caveat: Official price uses the published rounded value; no monthly ScienceDB outlier rule is newly applied to this series.

estimand.horizon_risk: R_mh = mean_i(mean_s((prediction_m,s,i,h-target_i,h)^2)) / mean_i(target_i,h^2), same test origins for both numerator and RW denominator.
estimand.single_market_primary: Equal mean of R_mh over H1/H5/H20 for this Tianjin tail. No cross-market macro or market-population estimand.
estimand.paired_effect: D(candidate,comparator)=R_comparator-R_candidate; positive means candidate improvement in RW risk units. Multiply by100 only when explicitly calling them RW percentage points.
estimand.relative_descriptive_effect: Also report1-R_candidate/R_comparator with its comparator-specific denominator; do not confuse it with RW percentage points.
estimand.seeds: Average seed squared errors at each origin before resampling. Seeds are algorithmic repeats, not independent time observations or markets.
estimand.secondary_ensemble: Average forecasts first only for a separately labelled three-seed ensemble secondary metric.
estimand.native: Report native MSE, both mean seed RMSE and sqrt(mean seed MSE) with labels, and MAE by horizon.

bootstrap.method: Circular moving blocks of observed forecast origins; uniform starts, blocks wrap modulo n, concatenate ceil(n/L) blocks and truncate to n. Same multiplicities for all models, all horizons and RW within each replicate.
bootstrap.rng_schedule: Initialize one numpy default_rng(20261019), process length20 first and length40 second; no seed search.
bootstrap.replicate_statistic: Recompute model/RW ratio per horizon in every replicate, then average three horizons and subtract paired risks.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Three primary-readout contrasts and two secondary-full contrasts form one family of five. Five individual99% percentile intervals give an approximate simultaneous95% family set by Bonferroni at primary block20. No extra horizon tests are added.
bootstrap.sensitivity: Display length40 results in full; it is sensitivity to dependence length, not a second chance to choose significance. Primary interpretation uses the preassigned length20, no post-result favorable-length choice.
bootstrap.zero_denominator: If any empirical resample has nonpositive/nonfinite RW denominator at any horizon, flag the affected length interval unavailable rather than silently omit such draws.
bootstrap.short_dependence_limit: 196origins permit about9 complete disjoint20-origin blocks or4 disjoint40-origin blocks; these are rough counts, not formal effective sample estimates. Irregular transaction records and H20 overlap limit evidence.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Conditional on frozen fitted models, validation choices, the acquired official snapshot and this fixed split. Does not correct the earlier model-development search globally or identify training uncertainty beyond shown seeds.

conclusions.retain_candidate_identities: allocation_readout remains this new stage primary and liquidity_full remains secondary regardless of results. Old V3 identities and results remain unchanged.
conclusions.reading: Assess effect sizes, horizon direction, interval width, comparisons with constant and published-structure baseline, and seed variation together. An interval crossing zero is inconclusive rather than proof of no practical value.
conclusions.single_market_limit: At most evidence of later-period replication for this official Tianjin source/target and this specified prediction experiment. A single market cannot confirm all carbon markets or establish causal shock allocation.
conclusions.selection_history: Explicitly state primary selection after prior V3/SWEWT outcomes and before this new-tail forecast evaluation; do not claim original all-stage preregistration.
conclusions.parameterization_limit: Preserve softplus constrained vs affine unconstrained local-update-scale caveat and distinguish initialization/prior performance from learned improvement.

integrity_checks: Freeze this plan SHA and all runner/model/helper sources in the new run protocol before fitting, recheck at completion.
Independently verify source identities, positive/finite data, dates, split and exact no-old-tail-date-overlap gate without selecting on forecasts.
Retain published rounded mean target; verify exact model targets p[t+h]-p[t], matched origins and H20 boundary maturity.
Reconstruct scales, weighted loss, EIA14day alignment and prior60volume reference; no new test-fitted preprocessing.
Require all15NPZ files and all50neural receipts; check checkpoint byte hashes, actual logged gradient steps and epoch0.
Recompute seed-average and separately ensemble errors from NPZ; retain all15families and all horizons.
Run exactly the five planned contrasts at both declared block lengths after completion; preserve unfavorable results.
